name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  windows-continuations:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@f40ffcd9367d9f12939873eb1018b921a783ffaa # v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: pnpm
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: pnpm turbo run build --filter=@stripe/link-cli...
      - run: pnpm --dir packages/cli test src/utils/__tests__/command-continuation.test.ts src/utils/__tests__/shell-quote.test.ts src/__tests__/continuation.test.ts src/commands/mpp/decode.test.ts src/commands/insights/__tests__/upgrade-command.test.ts

  python-sdk:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        python-version: ['3.11', '3.12', '3.13', '3.14']
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: packages/sdk-python
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@c771a70e6277c0a99b617c7a806ffedaca235ff9 # v9.0.0
        with:
          version: '0.9.22'
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
          enable-cache: true
          cache-dependency-glob: packages/sdk-python/uv.lock

      - run: uv python install
      - run: uv sync --locked
      - run: uv run --locked ruff check .
      - run: uv run --locked ruff format --check .
      - run: uv run --locked ty check
      - run: uv run --locked python -m unittest discover -s scripts
      - run: uv build
      - run: uv run --locked twine check --strict dist/*
      - run: uv run --locked python scripts/release.py validate
      - name: Test built wheel
        run: uv run --locked python scripts/test_wheel.py dist/*.whl

  agent-identity-node22:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@f40ffcd9367d9f12939873eb1018b921a783ffaa # v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: pnpm
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --filter @stripe/agent-identity...
      - run: pnpm --filter @stripe/agent-identity build
      # Build on the workspace runtime; test the SDK's supported consumer runtime.
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
      - name: Verify Agent Identity on Node 22
        working-directory: packages/agent-identity
        run: |
          node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run
          node --test example/step-up/server.test.mjs
          node scripts/check-package.mjs
          node scripts/check-docs.mjs
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4
        with:
          node-version: 22.0.0
      - name: Verify package on minimum supported Node
        working-directory: packages/agent-identity
        run: node scripts/check-package.mjs

  ci:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@f40ffcd9367d9f12939873eb1018b921a783ffaa # v4

      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: pnpm

      - uses: actions/setup-go@44694675825211faa026b3c33043df3e48a5fa00 # v6
        with:
          go-version-file: packages/sdk-go/go.mod
          cache-dependency-path: packages/sdk-go/go.mod

      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - run: pnpm turbo run build
      - run: pnpm turbo run typecheck
      - run: pnpm biome check .
      - run: pnpm turbo run test
      - name: Check Agent Identity package, examples, and documentation
        working-directory: packages/agent-identity
        run: |
          node --test example/step-up/server.test.mjs
          node scripts/check-docs.mjs
          node scripts/check-package.mjs
      - name: Test wallet and verifier integration
        working-directory: packages/agent-identity
        run: node --test test/wallet.test.mjs

      - name: Check Go SDK
        run: |
          unformatted="$(gofmt -l packages/sdk-go/*.go)"
          if [ -n "$unformatted" ]; then
            echo "The following Go files need gofmt:"
            echo "$unformatted"
            exit 1
          fi
          go -C packages/sdk-go mod tidy -diff
          go -C packages/sdk-go vet ./...

      - name: Test Go SDK
        working-directory: packages/sdk-go
        run: go test -race ./...

      - name: Verify publishable
        run: pnpm --filter @stripe/link-cli --filter @stripe/link-sdk --filter @stripe/link-integrations-better-auth --filter @stripe/link-integrations-eve --filter @stripe/agent-identity publish --dry-run --no-git-checks

{
  "name": "@stripe/link-integrations-better-auth-example",
  "private": true,
  "type": "module",
  "scripts": {
    "predev": "pnpm --filter @stripe/link-integrations-better-auth build",
    "dev": "next dev --hostname localhost",
    "build": "next build",
    "start": "next start --hostname localhost",
    "typecheck": "tsc --noEmit"
  },
  "engines": { "node": ">=22.13" },
  "dependencies": {
    "@stripe/link-integrations-better-auth": "workspace:*",
    "better-auth": "1.7.7",
    "next": "16.3.8",
    "react": "^19.3.0",
    "react-dom": "^19.3.0",
    "server-only": "0.0.1"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@types/node": "^26.6.4",
    "@types/react": "^19.3.0",
    "@types/react-dom": "^19.3.0",
    "typescript": "^7.0.2"
  }
}

[project]
name = "stripe-link-sdk"
version = "0.1.0"
description = "Typed synchronous and asynchronous clients for the Link API"
readme = "README.md"
authors = [{ name = "Stripe" }]
license = "MIT"
license-files = ["LICENSE"]
requires-python = ">=3.11"
dependencies = [
    "httpx>=0.28,<1",
    "pydantic>=2.10,<3; python_version < '3.14'",
    "pydantic>=2.12,<3; python_version >= '3.14'",
]

[project.urls]
Repository = "https://github.com/stripe/link-cli/tree/main/packages/sdk-python"
Issues = "https://github.com/stripe/link-cli/issues"

[build-system]
requires = ["uv_build>=0.9.22,<0.10.0"]
build-backend = "uv_build"

[tool.uv.build-backend]
module-name = "link"

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
asyncio_mode = "auto"
asyncio_default_fixture_loop_scope = "function"
testpaths = ["tests"]

[tool.ruff]
target-version = "py311"

[tool.ruff.lint]
select = ["E", "F", "I", "UP", "B"]

[tool.ty.environment]
python-version = "3.11"

[dependency-groups]
dev = [
    "pytest>=9.1.1",
    "pytest-asyncio>=1.4.0",
    "ruff>=0.16.7",
    "twine>=7.0.0",
    "ty>=0.0.81",
]
